conceptZh: 賽車用拉回發條撞倒第一塊骨牌，積木一路倒下排成鵝，神氣的鵝娃娃大搖大擺出場。
object: a pull-back toy race car and a row of brick dominoes with a goose plush
morph: dominoes topple and land as 鵝, with a proud goose strutting out
creativeAngle: 骨牌連鎖，神氣的鵝最後才登場。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale cloud-blue background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 鵝 as the only text on screen, drawn in coral red solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a googly-eyed pull-back race car is wound back with a loud squeak and springs forward, bumping the first of a row of colorful brick dominoes; the first 鵝 is spoken as the left 我 pieces tip into place. 1.7-3.4s: the bricks clatter across the stage, one flips and spins before joining; the second 鵝 is spoken as the 鳥 pieces on the right fall in a final long ripple. 3.4-5s: 大鵝 is spoken as a fluffy white goose plush with a red bowtie struts from behind the last brick, honking silently with head held high. 5-8s: hold; the race car squeaks to the goose's side and the goose pecks its antenna, glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "鵝、鵝、大鵝" (ㄜˊ、ㄜˊ、ㄉㄚˋ ㄜˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 鵝 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.

conceptZh: 披風英雄和布忍者拿橘色羽毛枕頭對決，披風蓋住頭、煙霧彈提早爆開，兩人各自揮空打轉，咚地撞頭坐倒，兩顆枕頭爆開的羽毛左邊落成「我」、右邊落成「鳥」拼出鵝，小天鵝滑過，兩人握手和好。
object: two plump pillows stuffed with bright tangerine goose feathers, one hugged by the long-caped hero, one by the felt ninja
morph: the head-BONK bursts both pillows; the hero's feathers settle on the left into 我 and the ninja's feathers settle on the right into 鳥, together forming 鵝 in solid tangerine strokes
creativeAngle: 改用「友誼對決」節奏：前一版是骨牌推倒的被動形成，這版讓鵝字直接從對決的撞擊中炸出來——枕頭裡的鵝羽毛就是筆畫材料，左右兩顆枕頭對應左「我」右「鳥」的結構，一眼看懂誰的羽毛變成哪一半。披風蓋頭與煙霧彈失誤是兩位角色的性格笑點，每1.5秒換一個動作；詞彙改選發音最安全的「天鵝」，由一隻小白天鵝在字完成後滑過畫面下方來對應。
promptEn:
An 8-second 2D-style animated clip on a pale mint background. The only text on screen is one Traditional Chinese glyph 鵝, which forms in solid tangerine-orange strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with clear margins. Only the hero, the ninja and two pillows are on stage; nothing busy behind.

0-1.5s: Showdown. On the left, a stocky caped action-figure hero with a cape three sizes too long hugs a plump pillow bursting with orange feathers; on the right, a tiny grey felt ninja hugs an identical pillow while "hiding" behind it in plain view, one eye peeking. The hero points a mighty finger at the ninja, and the cape immediately flops over his own head. He flings it back, grinning.

1.5-3s: The hero takes a huge wind-up swing, the cape flops over his face again, and he spins a full circle, missing by a mile as the first 鵝 is spoken. The ninja pulls a smoke bomb for a sneak attack, it pops in his own hand in a small grey puff, and he swings blind, missing too and spinning the opposite way.

3-4.5s: Both spin straight into each other: a big cartoon BONK of foreheads with squash-and-stretch, a frozen half-beat, then both pillows burst. Orange feathers blast upward in a soft cloud; the hero's feathers drift left and settle into the 我 half, the ninja's feathers drift right and settle into the 鳥 half, clicking into the crisp complete glyph 鵝 as the second 鵝 is spoken. The two sit down dazed with little spinning stars, well below the strokes.

4.5-8s: Hold. The glyph 鵝 stays perfectly still and fully readable for the final 3.5 seconds. A small white cartoon swan glides smoothly across the very bottom of the frame on a puddle exactly as 天鵝 is spoken, giving a silent honk. The hero and ninja wobble up, shake hands beneath the glyph, and the long cape flops over both their heads; two hands wave out from under it.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "鵝、鵝、天鵝" (ㄜˊ、ㄜˊ、ㄊㄧㄢ ㄜˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single characters, stopping after the word. No other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Soft cartoon squeaks and a gentle bonk, quieter than the voice. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
